resultados.refuerzo: Tratar de means to be about, so the question takes de.
Leer is an infinitive; te recomiendo que needs a subjunctive, leas.
Doblada means dubbed: the film's voices are replaced with Spanish ones.
La letra means the lyrics, the words written for a song.
No creo que takes the subjunctive, so sea; the indicative es does not fit.
Será is future; after no creo que the subjunctive sea is needed.
Fiable means reliable, a source you can trust.
Para que needs a conjugated verb, so mejoren, not the infinitive mejorar.
Un invento is something created that did not exist before.
The heat is a distractor; the question asks what the text names instead.
Another scientist is a distractor; the question asks for the agent named in the text.
Reciclar is an infinitive; es necesario que needs a subjunctive, reciclemos.
Es evidente que states a fact, so the indicative está fits, not the infinitive.
Me parece increíble que needs a subjunctive, desperdiciemos, not the infinitive.
La raíz is the root, the part of a plant that grows under the ground.
La rama is a branch, which grows above the ground, not under it.
La hoja is a leaf, which grows on the branches above the ground.
El león is the lion, a wild animal, unlike the domestic sheep and cat.
Regar is an infinitive; the sentence needs a first-person verb, riego.
A hurricane is a distractor; the question asks about the reason for leaving.
Learning languages is a distractor; the question asks about the reason to emigrate.
Adaptarse a means to adapt to, so a is the right preposition.
Ojalá always takes the subjunctive, so colaboren, not the indicative.
Una persona sin hogar is a person who has no home: homeless.
Repartir means to hand out, so she gives out breakfasts at the soup kitchen.
El codo is the elbow, the joint in the middle of the arm.
Poder is an infinitive; es una lástima que needs a subjunctive, puedas.
Una pulsera is a bracelet, worn around the wrist.
De shows the material: the ring is made of gold, un anillo de oro.
En means in or on; to say what something is made of, use de.
Con means with; to say what something is made of, use de.
El secador is the hairdryer, the appliance used to dry your hair.
Educado here means polite or well mannered, not educated.
El canguro is the babysitter who looks after children while parents are out.
El calabacín is the courgette, a vegetable sold at the greengrocer's.
La yema is the yolk, the yellow part of an egg.
Embutido is cured or cooked sausage, like chorizo and salchichón.
Manzanilla here means camomile tea, not the apple or beer.
Produce is the third-person singular present of producir, so it fits esta fábrica.
Una cola is a queue, the line of people waiting their turn.
